01 · How it works

You keep your systems. I build what is missing between them.

Most businesses already have good systems for accounting, sales and booking. The problem is what happens between them: data copied by hand, reconciliations in Excel and reminders someone has to remember.

I build the workflows in n8n, a workflow tool where an event – a paid invoice, a new order, a hired candidate – starts a chain of checks and steps. Every client gets their own n8n installation, and I monitor the workflows continuously.

Signs you need a workflow

  • The same data is entered into two or more systems.
  • Someone reconciles figures between systems every week or month.
  • You chase customers, clients or colleagues for the same information again and again.
  • The report you want needs data from several systems.

What the workflows typically do

  • Check and flag exceptions
  • Send reminders before deadlines
  • Create drafts in Fortnox
  • Sync status between systems
  • Compile reports from several sources
  • Alert when something gets stuck
  • Move data when you switch systems
  • Connect systems without a ready-made integration

Example: returns monitoring for e-commerce

  1. IN
    Return registeredIn the warehouse system (Ongoing WMS)
  2. n8n
    Workflow startsThe order is matched and checked
  3. SHOP
    Refund preparedDraft in the web shop for approval
  4. FTX
    Credit noteDraft created in Fortnox
  5. OUT
    Exceptions flaggedYou are notified if something does not match

The result: fewer manual steps, fewer missed errors and figures you can trust.

02 · Example workflows

Specific workflows, not general automation.

A few examples of what I build. Each workflow is scoped and priced on its own, and built around your systems and rules.

  • Missing-documents chaser · accounting firm

    Checks every night which clients are missing documents in Fortnox and sends reminders before VAT and payroll deadlines.

  • Client overview · accounting firm

    Hours, unbilled work and revenue per client in a weekly report, flagged when the margin is too low.

  • Stock and returns monitor · e-commerce

    Alerts for low stock, stuck orders and returns, with draft refunds and credit notes.

  • Margin per order · e-commerce

    Sales, purchase cost, shipping and fees combined into margin per order, product and channel.

  • Enquiry to consultation · clinic

    Enquiries from ads and the website are followed up until a consultation is booked. Only contact details and times are handled.

  • Green-tech deduction data · installer

    Paid invoices are checked against what Skatteverket requires, missing details are listed and the data is ready well before 31 January.

  • Enquiry to order · installer

    Enquiries from quote portals are collected, followed up and become a customer and project in Fortnox when the quote is signed.

  • Placement to invoice · staffing

    When a candidate is marked as hired in Teamtailor, a customer and draft invoice are created in Fortnox.

Clinic workflows never handle patient records, photos or treatment details – only contact details, times, amounts and consent.

Best fit

Businesses that have the systems but lack the connection.

My clients usually have 2–50 employees and use several systems that do not talk to each other.

  • You use Fortnox or Bokio

    And at least one other system – web shop, warehouse, recruitment system or booking.

  • Someone does the same thing every week

    Reconciliations, reminders or reports that take hours.

  • Mistakes cost money

    Missed deadlines, wrong stock levels or invoices that never go out.

  • You want to own the solution

    The workflows are documented and yours, even if you change supplier.

  • Not a good fit

    If a ready-made app solves the problem, or you only need a one-off export.

FAQ

Answers to the most common questions.

What do you do, in short?

I connect the systems a business already uses and automate recurring work between them, such as reminders, reconciliations, drafts in Fortnox and reports. I build in n8n and look after the workflows afterwards.

Do you build AI chatbots?

No, that is not my focus. I build integrations and automated workflows. Where AI is useful, for example to read a document, it can be one step in a workflow.

Why not Zapier or a ready-made app?

If a ready-made app covers your needs, I will recommend it. Your own workflow pays off when you have your own rules, several systems or systems without ready-made connections.

Do we need a Fortnox integration licence?

Yes, integrations with Fortnox require Fortnox's integration licence. It is included in some Fortnox packages and can otherwise be added. I will help you check what applies to you.

Who owns the workflows?

You do. Every client gets their own n8n installation and the workflows are documented. If we stop working together, you can take them over or hand them to someone else.

What happens if a system changes?

The workflows log errors and alert me. Minor adjustments when a system changes are included in the monthly fee.

How is personal data handled?

I act as a data processor and sign an agreement with every client. The workflows only handle the data they need, and hosting is within the EU. That does not make a solution automatically GDPR-compliant – it is assessed for each workflow.

How long does it take?

Mostly it depends on how quickly we get access to your systems. A scoped workflow moves fast once access is in place. You get a timeline in the proposal.

What does it cost?

A fixed price per workflow and a monthly fee for operation. The exact price is given after the first call, once I know which systems are involved. The call is free.

Do you still build websites?

Yes, but my focus is integrations and automation. Get in touch if you need both.
